name: Kualat: Notify about new links on Telegram

parameters.content:
## Notify about new links on Telegram

Every link created on kua.lat is sent to a Telegram chat.

**Set up:**
1. Install the **@kualat/n8n-nodes-kualat** community node under Settings → Community Nodes.
2. Create a **Kualat API** credential (API URL, for example `https://kua.lat/api`, and an API key).
3. Create a bot with @BotFather and put its token in the Telegram credential.
4. Fill in **Chat ID** with the target chat id (send a message to the bot, then check `https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates`).
5. Activate the workflow.
